message.content:
**Subject: Cherry and Apple Pollination — Three-Year Agreement Required**

Dear Grower,

Ferreira Apiaries has **900 strong colonies available** for the upcoming cherry and apple bloom.

Substantial winter colony losses across the valley have sharply reduced the supply of pollination-ready hives. Ferreira Apiaries also sustained losses, while our treatment and colony-management costs have increased considerably. Our pricing and booking terms reflect those realities and the strength of the colonies we will deliver.

For this season and the following two seasons, our terms are:

- **$420 per colony, per bloom season**
- **A signed three-year agreement**
- **Exclusive pollination service by Ferreira Apiaries for the acreage covered by the agreement**

These terms apply to all new and renewed cherry and apple pollination bookings. Last year’s pricing is no longer available, and colonies will not be reserved without a signed three-year agreement.

To secure an allocation from our 900 available colonies, please contact me promptly with your required colony numbers, orchard locations, and anticipated bloom timing. I will then issue the agreement and confirm your allocation. Hive strength, placement, scheduling, and other service requirements will be set out in the contract.

We have built our operation to provide dependable, strong colonies when bloom arrives. Growers who want that reliability for the next three seasons should confirm their requirements now.

Sincerely,  
**Gil Ferreira**  
Ferreira Apiaries
